description: This file re-exports specific functions and types from multiple modules related to a memory engine's query processing, session management, and process handling within a QMD (Query Management Domain) context.

classes.name: SessionFileEntry
classes.description: Type definition representing an entry for session files used in the memory engine.

methods.name: extractKeywords
methods.description: Extracts keywords from a query or text, used for query expansion.

methods.name: isQueryStopWordToken
methods.description: Determines if a token is a stop word in query processing.

methods.name: buildSessionEntry
methods.description: Creates a session file entry object for a given session.

methods.name: listSessionFilesForAgent
methods.description: Lists session files associated with a specific agent.

methods.name: sessionPathForFile
methods.description: Constructs the file path for a session based on input parameters.

methods.name: parseQmdQueryJson
methods.description: Parses JSON data representing QMD query results.

methods.name: deriveQmdScopeChannel
methods.description: Derives a scope channel identifier for QMD queries.

methods.name: deriveQmdScopeChatType
methods.description: Derives a chat type scope for QMD.

methods.name: isQmdScopeAllowed
methods.description: Checks whether a given QMD scope is permitted.

methods.name: checkQmdBinaryAvailability
methods.description: Checks if the QMD binary is available in the environment.

methods.name: resolveCliSpawnInvocation
methods.description: Resolves the command-line invocation for spawning QMD processes.

methods.name: runCliCommand
methods.description: Runs a command-line process related to QMD.
